Name: A New Custom NPC---BuwangYu
Author: LLLLLl6
Description:
[b][center][/center][/b]   On a sunny day, a mysterious NPC comes uninvited to the peaceful Valley of Stardew. He settles in a cave near a bus stop that leads to the desert. Since he came, when you pass the station occasionally hear a beast roaring, he seems to keep a mysterious beast... As a rancher in Stardew Valley, you, in order to keep the peace in Stardew Valley, you are going to take a closer look (and follow) to see if this new guy poses a threat...
[b]
Gender: [/b]Male
[b]Birthday: [/b]The 5th of spring
[b]Favorites:[/b] Cherry Bomb, Bomb, Super Bomb, Rainbow Shell, Rabbit's foot, Ghost Crystal
[b]Likes:[/b] emerald, aquamarine, ruby, amethyst, topaz, jade, gold ingot, iridium ingot
[b]Dislikes:[/b] decorative fans, shards of glass, ancient drums
[b]Hates:[/b] blackstone, Plasterstone, obsidian, SLATE

[b]Cardiac event trigger conditions:[/b]
[b]0 heart: [/b]Triggered on the 3rd, 13th and 23rd of each month when u passing a bus stop between 6am to 9pm.
[b]2 hearts: [/b]After seeing the 0 heart event, u have 2 hearts with BuwangYu, which is triggered when I pass the bus stop from 9:00 to 11:00 at night.
[b]4 Hearts: [/b]After watching the 2 Hearts event, u have 4 hearts with BuwangYu, which is triggered when you pass the forest map where Marnie lives from 6 am to 9 pm.
[b]6.1 Hearts:[/b] After seeing the 4 Hearts event, u have 6 hearts with BuwangYu, which is triggered when you pass the farm between 6am and 12pm.
[b]6.2 Hearts: [/b]After seeing 6.1 hearts event, u have 6 hearts with BuwangYu, which is triggered when you pass the bus stop between 6 am to 12 noon on Friday.
[b]8 hearts:[/b] After seeing 6.2 hearts event, u have 8 hearts with BuwangYu, at 11:00 PM to 12:00 PM when passing the bus stop triggered, note that this event will be directly saved for the second day, pay attention to the story of the problem, choose different answers will have different outcomes, please carefully choose!
[b]10.1 Hearts:[/b] After seeing the 8 Hearts event, u have 10 hearts with BuwangYu, triggered when you pass the farm between 6 am and 12 noon.
[b]10.2 Hearts: [/b]After reading 10.1 hearts event, u have 10 hearts with BuwangYu, triggered when passing the bus station from 6 am to 12 PM.
-- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -
[b]Post-marriage event trigger conditions:[/b]
[b]12 Hearts: [/b]After reading 10.2 hearts event, u have 12 hearts with BuwangYu, triggered between 8 and 12 P.M. when you pass through uncultivated land (the map you enter by the short cut back to the farm from Robin's house).
[b]14 Hearts:[/b] After reading 12 hearts event, u have 14 hearts with BuwangYu, which is triggered when u enter ur house from 10:00 PM to 12:00 PM. Note that after reading this event, u will enter the second day directly.
[b]
PS：[/b]This is LLLLLl6, and BuwangYu is my first child. The production may be a little rough, such as event design, character head picture and walking diagram. Because I have no painting experience, I only used a poor mouse to finish the portrait of the person and the crude CG drawing. From July 6th this year to the completion of August 13th today, during this period, the contents of his folder are more and more, he is more and more plump under my efforts (refers to the role shaping XD), as an old mother is really gratified. It's like watching a toddler grow into a full-fledged adult, so promise me you'll treat him right, okay? About how many conversations he actually has, I have no statistics and do not bother to count, if you think not enough I will add! If on the way to know him and found unreasonable places also please comment here, I will try to solve. One problem I have found is that he can only sleep on his stomach after becoming a partner. However, I have drawn a lovely sleeping position for him, but this game can't read it. Unfortunately, I haven't found a solution yet, and I hope to solve this problem in the near future. [b]Please don't let me see anything re-create and upload or even commercial, I will eventually defend my rights, thank you for your love ~[/b]
[b]
PPS: [/b]I don't mind native speakers in other countries translating my mod and contact me to add translation section , I really don't mind you draw his portrait or other png and contact me to upload.
